sub_answers.sub_question: Were there documented public controversies, complaints, or media criticisms about the fairness or transparency of that national selection?
Did any participants, music industry groups, or viewers file official complaints or appeals with the broadcaster or regulatory bodies?
Were there subsequent rule changes, investigations, or official statements from the broadcaster addressing criticisms after that edition?
What prominent opinion pieces, protest actions, or public debates in Lithuanian media discussed the selection’s musical or cultural representation?
How did Monika Liu’s streaming numbers, chart positions, and sales change following the national selection victory?
What record label, management, or publishing deals were involved with Monika Liu before and after the selection?
Which staging, visual design, and performance professionals were credited for Monika Liu’s national-final and international staging?
What were television viewership figures and public attendance numbers for the multiweek selection events that year?
What is the name, format, and typical schedule of Lithuania’s national selection for Eurovision in the relevant year?
Who is Monika Liu and what was the title and release date of the song she entered in the national selection?
How many heats/rounds, semifinalists, and finalists occurred in that edition of Lithuania’s national selection?
What was the final result of Monika Liu’s entry in the national final and any subsequent international contest ranking?
What were the official submission, artist eligibility, and song originality rules for that year’s Lithuanian national selection?
How were votes weighted between jury panels, international juries, and public televoting across the selection rounds?
What tie-breaking procedures and qualification criteria were specified for advancing between heats, semifinals, and the final?
Which broadcaster and production entities organized the selection and what technical production roles were credited (e.g., musical director, choreographer)?

Which public controversies, viewer complaints, or allegations of unfairness/transparency were reported in major Lithuanian or international media regarding the fairness of that country’s national selection process?

Did any contestants, record labels/music industry associations, fan groups, or individual viewers submit formal complaints, appeals, or petitions to the broadcaster and/or Lithuanian regulatory authorities about the outcome or process of that national selection?

After that edition aired, were there any documented changes to the selection rules or eligibility criteria, any broadcaster-commissioned reviews/audits, or any official press releases responding to allegations or criticism?

Which Lithuanian-language op-eds, interviews, TV/radio segments, social-media campaigns, or organized demonstrations debated whether the selection’s musical/cultural representation was appropriate, inclusive, or representative?

How did Monika Liu’s post-national-selection metrics (e.g., first-week streams, total streaming growth over subsequent weeks, peak chart ranks, and unit sales) evolve compared with her pre-selection levels?

Which specific label/brand partners, booking agencies, management teams, or publishing/rightsholder arrangements were documented for Monika Liu before the national selection and which changed (if any) in the months after winning?

Who were the credited creatives and production staff for Monika Liu’s national-final and international performances, including stage direction, choreography, LED/visual design, costume/styling, lighting/screen content, and overall show production?

What verified TV ratings (share/viewers) and in-person audience attendance figures are reported for the national multiweek selection events that year, and how do those figures compare across the different episodes?

What are the official title/name of Lithuania’s Eurovision national selection for the specific year in question, what are the event/format details (e.g., number of stages), and what were the dates or usual time window when it took place?

Provide an identification profile for Monika Liu (e.g., artist background/role) and cite the exact song title she submitted for Lithuania’s Eurovision national selection along with the song’s release date.

For that particular year’s Lithuanian Eurovision selection, what were the competition structure metrics: number of heats/qualifying rounds, total semifinalists (or qualifiers), and total finalists in the televised final?

What outcome did Monika Liu’s entry achieve in the Lithuanian national final (place/score if available), and did it receive any ranking or placement in any later international Eurovision event (cite the contest and result)?

For the specified year of Lithuania’s national selection, what did the official competition regulations state about: (a) deadline and method for submitting entries, (b) which artists were eligible to participate, and (c) what counted as an “original” song under the rules?

Across each round of Lithuania’s national selection that year (heats/semifinal/final), how did the rules specify the contribution of different voting components—domestic jury panels, any international jury groups, and public televote—to the final ranking (including any percentage weights)?

In that year’s Lithuania national selection, what were the formal tie-break rules and advancement/qualification requirements when participants had equal points—both for moving from heats to subsequent stages and for qualifying to the final (including any fallback criteria)?

Who were the named institutions responsible for organizing and producing Lithuania’s national selection that year (broadcaster and production company/entities), and which specific credited technical roles or functions were listed in official materials (e.g., musical director, choreographer, stage director)?
What publicly documented allegations, controversies, or press criticisms (in local or international outlets) questioned the fairness or transparency of that national selection process?

Which formal complaints, appeals, or petitions were submitted to the broadcaster and/or Lithuanian regulatory agencies by contestants, music-industry organizations, or audience groups regarding that selection?

After the edition aired, what official broadcaster responses, regulator findings, or changes to selection rules (eligibility criteria, jury composition, voting procedure) were announced in response to any objections?

Which Lithuanian-language opinion articles, editorials, or documented public demonstrations/campaigns debated whether that selection adequately reflected or represented particular musical styles or cultural identities?
After Monika Liu won the national selection, how did her streaming counts, chart rankings, and reported sales evolve week-by-week or milestone-by-milestone?

Which specific record label(s), management company(ies), and publishing/rights stakeholders partnered with Monika Liu prior to the national selection, and which new or expanded deals occurred after the win?

Who were the credited creators of Monika Liu’s staging and visuals (direction, choreography, creative production, set/LED/graphics, wardrobe/makeup, and performance coaching) for both the national final and the subsequent international performances?
For that year’s multiweek national selection events, what were the TV audience/viewership metrics and how many members of the public attended in person, including any breakdowns by night or round?

What was Lithuania’s Eurovision selection process in the relevant year (national final vs. multi-stage format), and what are the official name, broadcast/competition format details, and typical airing schedule for that edition?

Identify Monika Liu (background/billing) and provide the exact song title she competed with in Lithuania’s Eurovision national selection, including the song’s official release date and/or first public release timeframe.

For the specific edition of Lithuania’s Eurovision national selection that included Monika Liu, how many qualifying stages were held (heats/rounds), and how many acts were in the semifinal/round(s) and in the grand final?

What was Monika Liu’s placement and points/score in the Lithuanian national final, and where did the entry place afterward in the relevant international Eurovision contest (final ranking and/or overall position)?

For the given year of Lithuania’s national selection (name the contest), what were the official regulations on: (a) submission/entry deadlines and requirements, (b) which performers were eligible to participate (citizenship/age/professional status constraints), and (c) how “original” songs were defined and verified?

In that year’s Lithuanian national selection, how exactly were votes calculated and combined across the competition stages—specifically the percentage/weight given to each jury panel (e.g., national/regional panels), any international jury groups, and public televote/televoting—broken down by round (heats/semifinal/final)?

What were the documented tie-break rules and ranking/qualification thresholds used to decide outcomes in each stage of Lithuania’s national selection (from heats to semifinals to the final), including what happens when two entries receive equal points and how jury vs. televote discrepancies are resolved?

Who were the named organizers (broadcaster and any co-producers/production companies) for that year’s Lithuanian national selection, and which credited technical roles were specified in the official documentation (e.g., musical director, choreographer, stage director, creative producer, orchestra conductor, sound/lighting production roles)?
